author: Destial
body:
Age: 14
Timezone: GMT +8
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes, I do.
Do you have access to Skype? Yes, I do, though I rarely use it.
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes, I do. It's Dxtory (It may get some frame spikes when recording.)
Do you have access to Discord? Yes, I do.

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? 
Yes, I do have some experience. My rank was Head-Administrator, I lead the Staff Team of a faction server which has closed because of some financial issues.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? 
My biggest weakness is my timezone. Since I'm Asian and I live at the opposite side of this server, I won't be as active as U.S Players. So it will affect my moderating to me not being on-line where U.S Players are usually on-line. My biggest strength is my "Hacker Detection" skills. I can easily detect if a player is cheating as I've hacked too (not on Avicus of course) to understand the different clients, anti-cheat bypass, hack mods and how overpowered a client can affect a player. This would affect my moderating as I can easily tell if a player is hacking/cheating, so I would have them recorded and banned.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? 
I believe I can help because I'm very active on Avicus as I have "No Life". I also can try to help out if a mod is busy with their life activities.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? 
The qualities that a leader requires is;
- Selfless as they need to care about the players,
- Integrity as they need to be honest about rule breakers/non-rule breakers,
- Whole-heartedly with their duty as a leader,
- Kind as a rude staff member will not do his/her job that well,
- Determined to find the rule breaker that a player has reported,
- Helpful to others,
- Good communication(e.g. fluent English)
I consider myself as a leader because I've lead a team before in real life and in-game.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? 
Attributes that distinguish myself from other players is that I'm very active on the server, the forums, and now discord, I can easily detect hacks, I can lead players for their own good(e.g. If a cheater is playing, I tell the players not to join so that their Kill Death Ratio stats aren't affected), I can also communicate well with players and other staff members.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
The skills that I believe I should have is;
- Proper English,
- Proper Grammar,
- Proper Communication,
- Be kind with every word I say,
- No matter what circumstances, I will not take revenge on a player and will always stay humble.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
My usual on-line timings are (GMT +8) 4pm(1600) to 7pm(1900).
If I get trial-ed, I will try to get on around 4pm(1600) to 7:30pm(1930)


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
I would inform higher ranks like Mods or Senior Mods about the incident and take a screen-shot/video of the evidence that he is hacking and ban evading then sending the evidence to the higher ranks. In the meantime, I would freeze the player to stop him/her temporarily from affecting the game even more.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
I would inform the Senior Mods about the case and take a video about the incident and I will send it to the Seniors. In the meantime, I will try to stop the staff member from continuously harassing the other people.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
I would politely say to the reporter, "The evidence is corrupted. Would you kindly re-upload it? Greatly appreciated for you report!". In the meantime, I would then say to the player that appealed, "Sorry, we will need your patience while we solve this case. Sorry for any inconvenience caused!". Once the reporter has re-uploaded, I will say to the reporter, "Thanks for the reply!" then go back to the appealer and say,"Your punishment has been reduced to (duration). Thanks for waiting!".

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
Even if the screen-shot is not important, I will take note of this and inform the Officials or Senior Mods about this case. I would take a screen-shot of the evidence and send it to the Officials or Senior Mods.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
It the depends on the decision the Senior Staff team has made.
But if I don't agree with the decision, I would at least try to politely convince the Senior Staff team about my agreed choice. If the Senior Staff team still doesn't approve of my agreed choice, I will accept it and, if it affects my moderating, try to get used to it.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
It would mean a lot to me. By 'a lot', I mean a lot. It would also mean I get to ban those pesky rule breakers and make myself proud about doing something useful.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
As you can tell, I'm very active on Avicus. I love Avicus even though the server is based in Canada. Avicus is like my entire gaming life. If Avicus was down, I, too, was also 'down'.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
At the moment, I can only speak fluently in English. For imperfect language speaking, I speak Tagalog and Malay.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
This is my 2nd Application, I applied because I'm tired of hackers ruining our fun. I was also encouraged by shadowolfyt to apply. He vouched for me.

Thanks for taking the time to read this!

-Destial
 Referee of Avicus
